## What and why

Describe the problem, the change, and any related issue.

## Verification

List the commands you actually ran and their results. Include regression tests
for behavior changes and example inputs/outputs for new features.

## Safety and compatibility

Describe any SQL/YAML writes, output or schema changes, known limitations, and
migration needed. Use “not applicable” for documentation-only changes.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and removed credentials, private metadata, and generated database/log files.
- [ ] I updated relevant docs and the changelog for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I verified generated or AI-assisted changes rather than treating them as tested behavior.

See [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, tests, and source-preservation rules.
